data.name: EverestBaseCamp
data.detailed_description:
Everest Base Camp is a single-player management simulation game about running a high-altitude expedition base on Mount Everest.

In the first playable demo, you take command of a storm-damaged base camp and prepare a stranded client, Zhou He, for his first controlled expedition from Base Camp toward Camp I.

Your work begins in camp. Check client status, review the weather window, inspect the BC → C1 route, prepare medical supplies, and decide whether the team is ready to move. Preparation does not guarantee success — it lowers risk, unlocks better responses, and gives you more ways to handle trouble on the mountain.

Once the expedition begins, the game shifts from camp management to an action mission. The team moves along the BC → C1 route, and unexpected events may interrupt the climb: fatigue, route hazards, changing weather, and difficult calls about whether to push forward, adjust, use prepared supplies, request support, or safely turn back.

Every decision carries risk. A promising weather window may close. A client may not be ready. A route may become uncertain. Pushing too hard can damage the expedition, while turning back may preserve the chance to try again.

The current demo focuses on Chapter 1: restoring the base camp enough to support Zhou He’s first BC → C1 expedition.

Key Features

- Manage a storm-damaged Everest Base Camp

- Prepare a client for a controlled BC → C1 expedition

- Check weather windows, route conditions, supplies, and client readiness

- Make expedition decisions during fatigue, route, and weather events

- Use concrete preparations to unlock better responses during action missions

- Choose when to push forward, adjust, use supplies, request help, or turn back

- Experience story-driven events inspired by high-altitude expedition work

- Bring expedition results back to camp and prepare for what comes next

Everest Base Camp is currently in development. The first playable demo focuses on the early expedition route from Base Camp toward Camp I.

data.short_description: Manage Everest Base Camp, prepare climbers for dangerous expeditions, and guide your team from early route pushes toward an eventual summit attempt.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Apple Silicon
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
